title: Latency & bottlenecks
description: How long each hop takes (p50/p95/p99) from vendor to kitchen ticket and back, where an order's time goes, queue depths, and the slowest traces.

list.name: store
list.label: Store
list.description: Store slug (tenant) from the Pis' and hubs' resource labels.

panels.title: SQS wait p95
panels.description: SQS SentTimestamp to received by main, all stores (no store yet). Red over 30 s: main is not consuming; check main and SQS.

panels.title: Ingest p95
panels.description: Vendor placed_at to saved in main, incl. the online relay and SQS. Red over 30 s: compare with SQS wait to find the slow part.

panels.title: Dispatch p95
panels.description: Saved to the order frame delivered over SSE (outbox lag). Red over 10 s: outbox dispatch is slow or retrying.

panels.title: Pi ack p95
panels.description: Saved to acknowledged by the Pi (includes dispatch). Red over 30 s: the Pi link is flaky or the Pi is slow.

panels.title: Accept p95
panels.description: Arrival on the Pi to accepted on the tablet, the human hop. Red over 2 min: orders ring unattended.

panels.title: Print p95
panels.description: Accept to every ticket written (or given up). Red over 15 s: a printer is slow, timing out or failing over.

panels.title: Floor sync p95
panels.description: Floor-event time on the Pi to applied in main. Red over 60 s: the store's internet drops or main rejects events.

panels.title: RPC round trip p95
panels.description: main to Pi command round trip over the duplex channel. Red over 5 s: the link is degraded; see Duplex RPC in Debug.

panels.title: Hub poll p95
panels.description: One SoftTouch poll cycle in the hub. Red over 10 s: the POS database is slow or the store network is congested.

panels.title: Hub write p95
panels.description: One SoftTouch write by the hub (insert, assign, heal). Red over 10 s: writes may time out; check SoftTouch.

panels.title: Printer write p95
panels.description: TCP write to a printer. Red over 2 s: that printer is about to drop off the network.

panels.title: Unacked now
panels.description: Orders main holds that the Pi has not acknowledged for over a minute. Must be 0; red: an order may not be on the floor.

panels.title: Outbox pending now
panels.description: Rows waiting in main's outbox for these stores. Flat above 0: dispatch is stuck; check main's logs.

panels.title: SQS in flight now
panels.description: Messages main is processing right now (all stores). Stuck above 0: a message is hanging in the cast/save path.

panels.title: Average seconds per order, by hop
panels.description: Mean time per order in each hop over the range (ingest includes SQS wait; Pi ack includes dispatch). The longest machine bar is the bottleneck to fix first.

panels.title: p95 per store and hop
panels.description: Each store's p95 per hop over the range. A store red in one column has a local bottleneck there; red everywhere points at main.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant) (increase({__name__=~"orders_ingest_latency(_seconds)?_bucket", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant) (increase({__name__=~"orders_dispatch_latency(_seconds)?_bucket", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant) (increase({__name__=~"orders_ack_latency(_seconds)?_bucket", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant) (increase({__name__=~"floor_accept_seconds_bucket", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant) (increase({__name__=~"orders_print_seconds_bucket", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant) (increase({__name__=~"floor_sync_latency(_seconds)?_bucket", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant) (increase({__name__=~"rpc_roundtrip_duration_milliseconds_bucket", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range]))) / 1000
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant) (increase({__name__=~"hub_poll_seconds_bucket", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant) (increase({__name__=~"hub_write_seconds_bucket", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant) (increase({__name__=~"printer_write_duration_milliseconds_bucket", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range]))) / 1000

panels.title: main queues
panels.description: Outbox pending per handler, SQS messages in flight and orders unacked by a Pi. All should hug zero; a plateau is a stuck stage.

panels.title: Pi queues
panels.description: Orders waiting to accept and floor events not yet synced to main, per store. A growing line is where work piles up.

panels.title: Hub lag
panels.description: Hub feed lag behind the Pi's cursor and the age of the hub's last status. Rising lines: the hub is falling behind or stuck.

panels.title: Slow order ingests (main, over 2 s)
panels.description: main's sqs.process traces slower than 2 s (not store-filtered: the store is unknown until routing). Sort by duration and open one to see the slow span.

panels.title: Slow Pi spans (over 1 s)
panels.description: Pi spans slower than 1 s for the selected stores (printing, order arrival, RPC handlers). Open one to see which printer or step stalled.

panels.title: Slow hub spans (over 5 s)
panels.description: Hub spans slower than 5 s for the selected stores (SoftTouch polls and writes). Repeated slow polls mean the POS database is struggling.
